items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I joined Claude at the Regal Theatre in Chicago. That's 1934.

ctx.x: He was there--he was with Jeter and Pillars in St. Louis.

But I got that job for them, for Jeter and Pillars. You know, Claude Hopkins had just left St. Louis and these guys at the Plantation asked Claude to look for a group for them, and when Claude heard me, and I had made arrangements to join his band later in Chicago, because I told him that I wanted to go down to St. Louis with Jeter and Pillars to help them hold that job--
You were going to open up for them?
